title: FAA Aviation Mechanic Powerplant
description: Aviation Mechanic Powerplant: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
sourceShort: FAA handbooks, the ACS and 14 CFR
notice: Contains material from 14 CFR parts 33, 43, 65 and 91, the FAA Aviation Mechanic General, Airframe, and Powerplant Airman Certification Standards and its Companion Guide, the Aviation Maintenance Technician Handbooks – Powerplant (FAA-H-8083-32B) and – Airframe (FAA-H-8083-31B), and Advisory Circular 43.13-1B, which are US Government works in the public domain; some handbook images are third-party material and are not reproduced. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by the Federal Aviation Administration, the U.S. Department of Transportation or PSI Services LLC. The Aviation Mechanic Powerplant knowledge test (AMP) is an FAA test delivered at PSI testing centres.

changelog.notes: Released, after an independent audit of every card against its source.

checks.what: Six independent audits read all 1892 cards against the FAA sources they quote (the Aviation Mechanic ACS, the AMT Handbook — Powerplant FAA-H-8083-32B, the Airframe handbook, AC 43.13-1B and 14 CFR), found word for word by the card checker; every number and both propeller figures were checked
checks.result: Three wrong cards fixed: two on what a powerplant mechanic may do with a major overhaul (14 CFR 65.81, 65.87, part 43 appendix A) and a propeller angle; the propeller range figure redrawn to Figure 7-3's values; 11 unsupported claims removed; 3 ambiguous and 9 unclear cards fixed; topic 8 cut to budget and cards that repeated the General deck deleted.

openReviews: the current text of 14 CFR parts 33 and 65 could not be checked: eCFR refuses automated requests and govinfo's 1 January 2025 edition may miss later amendments
38 topic 3 cards restate 14 CFR facts the General deck already teaches (Appendix A and D items, 43.9, 43.10, 91.417, 91.421): decide whether to keep them as revision or cut them
